title: The Sandbox Build-Log: What are we making?
author: The Sandbox Réseau Team
excerpt: Welcome to our space for builders. No panels. No pitches. Just people in a room thinking out loud.
content:
Hi there,

This is the first of many updates you’ll receive from us this year. If you’re reading this, you’re officially part of the Sandbox Reseau community, and we’re glad to have you here.

Thanks for reading Sandbox Réseau! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.

At its core, Sandbox Reseau is a space for builders, founders, and change-makers to have honest conversations about what they’re building, what they’re learning, and what isn’t quite working yet.

No panels. No pitches. Just people in a room thinking out loud.

What to expect in your inbox

This newsletter is our “quiet corner of the internet.” We’ll keep it simple and consistent:

  • Ecosystem Updates: What’s happening in our world.
  • Opportunities: Funding, programs, and collaborations worth your time.
  • Community Spotlights: A look at a fellow builder and the problem they are solving.
  • Sound Bites: Insights from resource people on issues that matter.

Upcoming Event: February Meetup

Our first meetup of the year is happening on 27th February 2026.

Important: Timing Change To make the session more accessible, the event will now run from 15:00 – 17:00 GMT (instead of the previously communicated 17:00 – 19:00 GMT). We apologise for any inconvenience this shift may cause!

Spots are limited and filling up quickly. If you haven’t registered yet, consider this your cue.

Register here

What are you building?

We want to create a shared “Build-Log” so we can all be more aware of each other’s journeys. Whether it’s a global startup, a community project, or a weekend experiment, we want to hear about it.

This helps us know how to support, collaborate, and highlight your work in future spotlights.

Tell us about your project here:

Fill out the Sandbox Build-Log

We’re excited about what we’ll build together this year. Thanks for being part of the journey.

Warm regards,

The Sandbox Reseau Team

Thanks for reading Sandbox Réseau!
